paragraphs.text: The post that traveled was a font.
shipped Geist Serif and the likes piled up.

wrote that there are only two ways to make money in software, bundling and unbundling, and that AI is speed-running the bundling. Seven likes. If this file is a daily pass on the work, it is mostly a pass on what already has an audience. The design problem in a bundling phase is what you refuse. Almost nobody here is being paid to refuse.
are already dropping the idea that a prompt is a product. Both are selling a model that can see the file you have and edit inside it. That is a retreat, and a correct one.

, on October 15, is the piece to read next to it. A feature can work and still make the product worse. Agents let people add, separately, until the product is an average of those additions and you cannot feel anyone behind it.
’s note is the same argument with a knife in it: remove the animations, then improve what is left, then check that it is actually fast.

posted that the future belongs to designers who build. The sentence names one career and hides a split. Someone generates. Someone else deletes the motion, puts a before and an after in the pull request, and designs the screen where the model is wrong.
’s folder of DESIGN.md files, offered so a coding agent can be given taste, is a costume of that second job.
is the real version of the hope: agents will follow the rules if a person with a point of view wrote them and can still throw them out.
